subject: Concordia integration: local dev kit & auth/routing checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Novak <alex@concordiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Concordia integration: local dev kit & auth/routing checklist

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Short version up top, details below.

Recap (what we demoed)
- Redwood hosted API + Dedicated routing examples (latency vs cost tradeoffs)
- SDK quickstart (Python + TypeScript sample apps) and structured output / tool-calling for clinical workflows
- Embeddings + reranker sketch for patient note search and semantic match

Immediate asks / next steps (for Concordia)
1) Sandbox access: please confirm the email to provision a sandbox API key (we'll issue a scoped key limited to dev tokens).
2) Network checklist: see attached concordia-devkit-network-reqs.pdf — we need outbound egress to our API endpoints, and a short list of allowed ports for the local dev runners.
3) Local sample run: clone the attached redwood-sdk-sampleapps.zip or the Drive link below; there are Python and TS examples that run locally against a sandbox key.
4) Auth model: we recommend a short-lived service account for CI and a developer key for local testing. We'll send an example IAM policy.
5) Embeddings/rerank: we suggested starting with a small reranker flow (embed -> knn -> rerank). If Concordia wants, we can provide a starter prompt set and a small evaluation harness.

Timeline suggestion
- This week: provision sandbox key + infra confirms network (Concordia)
- Early next week: 60–90 minute pairing session (engineering + infra) to run through local bootstrap and sample app
- Two weeks: POC with a small dataset (search reranker flow)

Attachments included: concordia-devkit-network-reqs.pdf, redwood-sdk-sampleapps.zip, concordia-mapping-quickstart.md

Links: hubspot record + sample repo -> https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2B3C-sdk-samples

Questions for you before we pair:
- Do you have a preference for Python vs TypeScript for the initial POC? (We can run both; TS is lighter for frontend integration.)
- Any compliance constraints we should flag now (e.g., no outbound to third-party clouds, must use VPC egress)?

I'll book a 60-minute slot for next Tue unless you prefer Wed.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: Concordia integration: local dev kit & auth/routing checklist

Sean — really useful recap, thank you. A few quick clarifications from the infra side so we can move fast: 

1) Sandbox provision email: infra@concordiahealth.com (please copy me).
2) Network: we're cloud-hosted on Azure (primary region us-east). Outbound is allowed but we need IP ranges for firewall rules — can you provide CIDR or FQDNs?
3) Sample apps: can you confirm the minimum Node / Python versions and whether Docker is required for the TS sample? Our devs prefer local without docker if possible.
4) Embeddings/rerank: our primary ask is snippet-level search across patient notes (PHI). We'll need guidance on minimal redaction and whether embeddings should be generated on-prem or can be sent to a hosted instance for the POC.

Also timeline: we can aim for the pairing session on Tue 2026-06-30 (AM). POC in two weeks is fine.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Novak
Director, Product Engineering | Concordia Health
alex@concordiahealth.com

Alex — great, thanks for the quick replies and the preferred sandbox provisioning email. A few answers inline and a couple of concrete artifacts to move forward: 

- CIDRs / endpoints: attaching the short list (we generally publish FQDNs, but for firewalls we can provide a narrow set of IP ranges for the sandbox region). See concordia-devkit-network-reqs.pdf.
- Runtimes: Node 18+ recommended for TS sample (no Docker required for local dev — we provide a lightweight script that runs the local server). Python 3.10+ for the Python sample. Both samples work from source with a sandbox key.
- PHI & embeddings: for POC we recommend redaction at ingestion (PII/PHI scrub) unless you want an on-prem embedding flow. We can run hosted embeddings under a Private deployment if required (we'll include KMS/HSM options). I'll have the short eval notes from Karthik ready for the pairing.

Pairing session: Tue 2026-06-30 at 10:00 AM ET — I'll send a calendar invite. Agenda: 1) network & keys 2) local sample run (TS + Python) 3) reranker sketch + eval harness 4) next steps for procurement.

Links to starter artifacts:
- Starter samples (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2B3C-sdk-samples
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/8342

If anything changes on timing, let me know — otherwise I'll send the invite and provision a scoped sandbox key for infra@concordiahealth.com.

Thanks,
Sean
